axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. Creature faces glTF +Z (Blender -Y), ground contact at y = 0; the engine turns it with yaw(angle) * rot_y(PI).

rig.core: GF_Hero_v1 core names and parents (23 bones, docs/ART_PIPELINE.md section 5)
rig.skinning: rigid: every part on one bone
rig.axes: bone +Y along the bone, +Z toward the front (Ashen Covenant roll convention)

plate_states.rule: Set these joint scales every frame AFTER the animation system and before transform propagation: every clip keys the plate joints (at scale 1, plates_break at the cracked state), so the client's state wins. 0 may be 0.001 (the clips use 0.001). Keep a plate cracked while plates_break plays.
plate_states.sim_signals: EntityFlags::PLATED while plate_hp is left; GameEvent::PlatesShattered when it runs out; GameEvent::Hit per hit (amount after resist, element) for a client-side plate-wear estimate.
plate_states.suggested: spawn intact; while PLATED, estimate wear = sum of Hit amounts x 1.5 for Kinetic (resisted) and x 0.5 for other elements (gf_core::damage::apply_plating), and crack plates in crack_order as wear / plate_hp passes crack_at; on PlatesShattered set every plate cracked, play plates_break once (it flings the fragments), then hold stripped; a brute without PLATED is stripped
plate_states.fallback: with no client support both layers stay at scale 1: the intact plates hide the cracked copies (inset 3-7 %), so the model reads intact

clip_roles.anvil_brute_idle@loop: hunched on its knuckles, the chest heaves and lifts the anvil, the visor looks around
clip_roles.anvil_brute_move@loop: knuckle walk: fists and feet planted in diagonal pairs, the torso rolls under the anvil
clip_roles.anvil_brute_windup: the overhead slam wind-up: gathers, rears up on its legs, both fists clasped overhead (3.8 m) (anticipation; the engine draws the red-white charge telegraph); ends on the loaded pose
clip_roles.anvil_brute_attack: the slam that launches the charge: both fists hammer the ground in front (impact at 0.17 s, sockets impact_L/R) and it drives forward into the charge posture
clip_roles.anvil_brute_charge@loop: the charge: a head-down bounding gallop behind the anvil (play while the sim's CHARGING flag is set)
clip_roles.anvil_brute_hit: a flinch back; the plates rattle with the chest
clip_roles.anvil_brute_death: jolts, sags to its knees and crashes face-down onto its fists under the anvil (held)
clip_roles.anvil_brute_plates_break: the plates shatter (GameEvent::PlatesShattered): it rears up roaring, arms flung wide, and the cracked fragments fly off, tumble and vanish; plate_* joints are keyed hidden

clip_playback.windup: time-stretch to the Charger windup (0.9 s), hold the last frame
clip_playback.attack: play when CHARGING starts (0.55 s = the charge duration: the slam launches the charge)
clip_playback.charge@loop: loop while CHARGING after attack ends (visual cadence, 1.0-1.5x; not stride matched)
clip_playback.plates_break: one-shot on GameEvent::PlatesShattered, layered or played as a reaction; then stripped
